agreement.parent: Independent web search and source review; prefers focused reusable explorer, configurable theme/title/filter and native paths.
agreement.opus: Reconsidered four compatible candidates and agreed to ratatui-explorer with narrow error/empty-state guards.

alternatives: tui-file-explorer 2.3.0: richer but current renderer slices long Unicode paths at arbitrary byte boundaries; write-operation and renderer integration need more adaptation.
ratatui-interact 0.5.3: ready file component inside a wider toolkit, with swallowed navigation errors and less customizable footer.
ratatree 0.4.0: viable new list/tree picker with fuzzy search; additional modes are not needed for this focused /files integration.
contract: Use the real library navigation/state/widget, not a custom navigator backed only by filesystem helpers.
Use library set_cwd rather than the failure-prone handle(Right) branch; preserve selection on return.
Guard empty input and renderer paths because the library widget accesses current().
Allow browsing parent directories; execution cwd, sessions and provider settings stay unchanged.
File reads remain explicit and read-only with bounded regular-file previews; keep syntect/two-face.
No new sidebar or replacement application runtime; retain other pages.
status: implementation authorized and dispatched; not yet accepted or installed
